plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Albentia wireless device. It reports uptime, temperature, and interface traffic (enterprise PEN 28087).
name: Wireless

metrics.name: rf_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: RF temperature of the Albentia wireless device. The SNMP Integer32 uses two implied decimal places, so the query divides the raw value by 100 before display and alert evaluation. High values can indicate poor airflow, enclosure heat buildup, or radio hardware thermal stress.

metrics.name: sector_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Per-sector temperature where the device exposes it. The SNMP Integer32 uses two implied decimal places; the query divides by 100 so the metric is reported in Celsius. Empty sector tables produce no rows.

metrics.name: tx_power
metrics.description: Per-sector radio transmit power in dBm. The SNMP Integer32 is used as reported with no scaling. Empty radio-info tables produce no rows. Target RSSI is a configuration object and is not treated as measured RSSI.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
